adjudication.rationale: In the new addGuestsHandler, attendees are persisted first via prisma.booking.update(... attendees.createMany ...) and only afterwards the external side-effect sync runs via eventManager.updateCalendarAttendees(evt, booking). If that calendar update throws, there’s no transaction/rollback shown in this diff, so a failure could leave DB attendees added but calendar state unsynced. The finding’s point about needing coverage for this partial-failure scenario is a specific test gap tied to this new write-then-sync flow (though the diff itself doesn’t show the existing test suite to confirm absence).
